title: Float Alternative for Agency Utilization (2026)
summary: Float alternative for agency utilization in 2026. Own capacity and retainer load in Taskade Genesis. Compare Float and Runn seat pricing before you buy.
body_markdown:
Agencies buy Float when utilization becomes a spreadsheet fight. Runn shows up in the same SERP with resource seats and a minimum floor that can sting smaller studios. Both are strong planners. Both charge for the people you schedule. In 2026, a different question is fair: do you need a dedicated resource-management product, or a living utilization board inside the same workspace where delivery already happens?


This guide is an honest[Float alternative](https://www.taskade.com/generate/agency-workflows/float-utilization) path for agencies that want capacity visibility without turning headcount into a second SaaS tax.[Taskade Genesis](https://www.taskade.com/create?entry_kind=content&source=blog&entry=%2Fblog%2Ffloat-alternative-agency-utilization) is not Float. It is not a full PSA (professional services automation) suite. It is Projects +[AI agents](https://www.taskade.com/agents) +[automations](https://www.taskade.com/automate) + App UI shaped into a utilization and capacity board you own.


> **TL;DR:** Float (~$7 Starter / ~$12 Pro per scheduled person / month, annual-style list pricing) and Runn (resource seats, often ~$7-$13/seat with a common 20-seat minimum on paid plans) win when scheduling UX and finance dashboards are the product. Taskade Genesis wins when utilization must live next to client work, delivery tasks, and agents. Start with the[Float alternative agency utilization](https://www.taskade.com/generate/agency-workflows/float-utilization) kit and the[agency capacity planning board](https://www.taskade.com/generate/agency-workflows/agency-capacity-planning-board) .


Confirm live vendor pricing before you buy. Figures below are public 2026 ranges used for budget sketches. For the feature-by-feature view that sits alongside this guide, see the[Taskade Genesis vs Float comparison](https://www.taskade.com/compare/free-float-alternative) .

## What utilization actually means on Monday


Utilization is not a vanity chart. It is four questions:


1. Who is overbooked this week?
2. Who has slack you can sell?
3. Which clients are consuming more hours than scoped?
4. What happens if that pitch closes next Tuesday?


Float answers these with a beautiful schedule. Taskade Genesis answers them by making capacity a first-class board in the same workspace as projects and client portals.


Monday question Float / Runn default Taskade Genesis board


Who is over 100%? Schedule heat / capacity views Capacity board + person records


Soft vs hard bookings Native planner semantics Status fields you define (tentative / confirmed)


Actuals vs plan Pro-tier time / estimates features Time fields + weekly rollup views (honest, lighter)


Tie to delivery tasks Integrations / exports Same Projects agents already update


AI "who is free for X?" Limited product AI Agent query over live capacity records


Pitch what-if modeling Strong in dedicated RM tools Scenario project + capacity board clone


If you only need a world-class schedule canvas, stay with Float. If you need the schedule to argue with the delivery board in one system, keep reading.
